item.title: 'Destination: Disney Destiny': Heroes and villains abound aboard Disney Cruise Line's newest ship
item.description: Come onboard the newest ship in the Disney Cruise Line fleet, where it's all about Disney heroes and villains!

item.title: Kianna Underwood, former Nickelodeon star, killed in hit-and-run at 33
item.description: Law enforcement officials say Kianna Underwood, a former Nickelodeon child star, was killed Friday in a hit-and-run in New York. She was 33.

item.title: Trump says 8 European countries will be charged 10% tariff for opposing US control of Greenland
item.description: President Donald Trump says he'll charge a 10% import tax starting in February on goods from eight European countries because of opposition to U.S. control of Greenland.

item.title: SF firefighters rally for retiree denied cancer treatment by Blue Shield as more come forward
item.description: On the steps of San Francisco City Hall, firefighters joined forces to fight for one of their own: retired firefighter Ken Jones, who was denied treatment by Blue Shield for his stage 4 lung cancer. We're now learning that Jones isn't the only SFFD firefighter who has been denied treatment by the provider.

item.title: Health experts warn about potentially deadly herbal substance, after 6 overdose deaths: What to know
item.description: The California Department of Public Health is sounding the alarm on Kratom, as well as a potent derivative of the plant called 7-OH, in the wake of six recent overdose deaths in Los Angeles County. Kratom and 7-OH products are not FDA-approved and are not legal for retailers to sell.

item.title: Thousands march in Greenland to support Arctic island in the face of Trump's threats to take it over
item.description: They held signs of protest, waved their national flag and chanted "Greenland is not for sale" in support of their own self-governance in the face of increasing threats of an American takeover.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Patchy fog overnight with sunny week ahead
item.description: We can expect passing high clouds and patchy valley fog to return overnight. The week ahead will bring us a continuing pattern of mostly sunny and mild afternoons.

item.title: Seahawks dominate 49ers from opening kick, advance to NFC title game with 41-6 win
item.description: The San Francisco 49ers' playoff season has come to an end after a devastating 41-6 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: New photos show 2 cars believed to be involved in Stockton mass shooting that left 4 dead
item.description: As investigators try to track down those responsible for a mass shooting at a child's birthday party, new surveillance images show two vehicles believed to be involved.

item.title: Thousands of Grateful Dead fans pay tribute to Bob Weir at public memorial in San Francisco
item.description: Thousands of people gathered in San Francisco to say goodbye to Grateful Dead co-founder and guitarist Bob Weir on Saturday. The rock and roll legend died last week at the age of 78.
